blocks.text: Hydrogen ka oxide, pani, kemiyai formula H2O rakhta hai. Yeh bazahir saada molecule bohat si hairat-angez khususiyat (properties) rakhta hai, jo ise "zindagi ka zariya" (medium of life) ka darja deti hain. Hamare jism ka taqreeban do tihai pani hai aur hum is ke baghair nahin reh sakte. Yeh tamam jandaron (organisms) mein sab se zyada paya jane wala compound hai; mukhtalif jandaron mein is ki miqdar 65 se 89 fisad tak hoti hai, aur kaseer-khalvi (multicellular) jandaron mein tissue se tissue tak badalti hai: haddi ke cells mein taqreeban 20 fisad pani hai aur dimagh ke cells mein 85 fisad. Pani zindagi ke madde (protoplasm) ko banane aur qaim rakhne mein aur zindagi ke kaam ke liye munasib mahol (environment) banane mein aham kirdar ada karta hai.
Hal karne (solvent) ki khususiyat

Pani ki bohat se maddon ko hal karne ki salahiyat (ability) do khususiyat ki wajah se hai: pani ke molecules ka polar hona aur un ki hydrogen bonds banane ki salahiyat. Pani ke molecule ke alag-alag sire hain, har ek par juzvi (partial) charge: hydrogen atoms juzvi musbat (positive) aur oxygen atom juzvi manfi (negative). Aise molecules polar molecules kehlate hain. Ek pani ke molecule ke ek sire ka juzvi manfi charge doosre ke juzvi musbat charge ki taraf khincha jata hai; yeh kamzor kashish (attraction) hydrogen bond hai, aur pani aise bonds ka ek jaal banata hai. Pani ki bohat si khususiyat is ke hydrogen bonds ki wajah se hain.

blocks.title: Hydrogen bonding ke baghair
blocks.text: Hydrogen bonding ke baghair pani manfi 80 degree Celsius par ubalta aur manfi 100 degree Celsius par jamta, jo zindagi ko na-mumkin bana deta.

Kyunke pani ke molecules polar hain, yeh har aise molecule ke gird jama ho jate hain jis par electrical charge ho, chahe poora charge (ions) ho ya juzvi (polar molecules). Jab sodium chloride (namak) pani mein dala jata hai to yeh musbat (Na+) aur manfi (Cl-) ions mein toot jata hai, aur in ions ko pani ke molecules ke mukhalif polar sire gher lete hain. Isi tarah jab glucose pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules glucose ke polar hydroxyl groups se hydrogen bonds banate hain, aur yun glucose hal ho jata hai. Is liye charge wale ya polar molecules pani mein hal hote hain. Mahlool (solution) ki halat mein ions aur molecules aasani se ek doosre se reaction kar sakte hain, is liye pani kemiyai reactions, yani cells ke metabolism, ka zariya mohayya karta hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose ka ring (ring mein aik oxygen) jis se chaar -OH groups aur aik -CH2OH group bahar ki taraf hain. Har group ke aage aik pani ka molecule (surkh oxygen, do safed hydrogen) hai jo nuqtedar neele hydrogen bond se juda hai. Note kehta hai pani glucose ke polar -OH groups se hydrogen bonds banata hai, is liye glucose ghul jata hai.
blocks.caption: Organic molecules (glucose) ke liye pani bator solvent (Figure 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Pani ka molecule, teer, phir hydroxyl ion OH- (aik hydrogen wala oxygen aur manfi charge, bond ke dono electrons apne paas) jama hydrogen ion H+. Neeche equation H2O <=> H+ + OH- hai, aur note kehta hai kisi bhi lamhe pani ke bohat thore molecules ionise hote hain.
blocks.caption: Pani ka hydroxyl ion aur hydrogen ion mein ionization (Figure 4.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Hydrophilic aur hydrophobic
blocks.text: Charge wale ya polar molecules jaise namak, sugars aur amino acids pani mein aasani se hal hote hain aur hydrophilic ("pani-pasand") kehlate hain. Be-charge ya non-polar molecules jaise lipids pani mein hal nahin hote aur hydrophobic ("pani se darne wale") kehlate hain.
Hydrophobic exclusion

Non-polar ya be-charge molecules pani mein hal nahin hote kyunke pani ke molecules un se hydrogen bonds nahin banate. Jab unhen pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules unhen bahar dhakel dete hain, aur na-hal-hone wale molecules aapas mein hydrophobic jor banate hain. Maslan lipid molecules pani mein hal nahin hote; jab unhen pani se nikala jata hai to woh aapas mein mazboot jor banate hain, isi liye lipids cells ki membranes qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar panels. Ek pani ka molecule jis ka oxygen juzvi manfi aur dono hydrogens juzvi musbat nishan-zada hain. Nuqtedar hydrogen bonds se jure pani ke molecules ka jaal. Ek sodium ion ko ghere pani ke molecules jin ke manfi oxygen sire us ki taraf hain. Pani ke andar ikatthi hui tel ki ek boond, jis ke gird pani ke molecules hain.
blocks.caption: Polarity, hydrogen bonding, pani bataur solvent aur hydrophobic exclusion (Figures 4.6 se 4.9 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Oxygen share-shuda electrons ko khenchta hai, is liye pani ka molecule polar hai jis ka oxygen sira juzvi manfi aur hydrogen sire juzvi musbat hain. Har molecule apne parosiyon se hydrogen bonds banata hai, jo pani ko cohesion, surface tension, ooncha specific heat aur ooncha heat of vaporisation deta hai. Na+ jaise ion ke gird pani ke molecules ke mukhalif charge wale sire jama ho jate hain, aur glucose ke polar hydroxyl groups isi tarah hydrogen bond hote hain, is liye namak aur sugars hal hote hain. Tel jaise non-polar molecules pani se hydrogen bond nahin bana sakte, is liye pani unhen ikattha dhakel deta hai; yeh hydrophobic exclusion lipids ko jorne aur membranes banane deta hai.

blocks.text: Heat capacity

Specific heat capacity woh calories ki tadaad (garmi ki miqdar) hai jo kisi madde ke 1 gram ka darja-hararat (temperature) 15 se 16 degree Celsius, yani 1 degree, barhane ke liye chahiye. Pani ki specific heat capacity oonchi hai, 4.184 joules, jis ka matlab hai ke pani apne darja-hararat mein kam se kam tabdeeli ke saath garmi jazb (absorb) aur kharij karne ki bari salahiyat rakhta hai. Pani ki jazb ki hui zyada tar garmi us ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torne mein istemal hoti hai; jab bonds toot-te hain to alag-alag molecules zyada azadi se harkat karte hain aur darja-hararat barhta hai. Oonchi specific heat ki wajah se pani aahista garam hota hai, aur thande mahol mein apna darja-hararat der tak rakhta hai. Yun pani jandaron ke andaruni aur bahari mahol dono ke liye darja-hararat ko mustahkam (stabilise) rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitni oonchi
blocks.text: Pani ki specific heat zyada tar carbon compounds se dugni aur lohe (iron) se nau guna zyada hai.
Heat of vaporisation

Heat of vaporisation woh garmi hai jo kisi maaye (liquid) ko gas mein badalne ke liye chahiye. Pani ka heat of vaporisation ooncha hai, 574 kilocalories fi kilogram: 1 kilogram maaye pani ko bhaap mein badalne ke liye khasi garmi (574 kilocalories) chahiye, is liye pani maaye se gas bante hue bohat garmi jazb karta hai. Yeh khususiyat zameen ka darja-hararat motadil (moderate) rakhti hai aur podon aur janwaron ko transpire aur paseena (sweat) nikalte waqt thandak deti hai: poday ya janwar ki satah se bhaap banne wala har gram pani jism se 574 calories garmi le jata hai.

blocks.title: Thori bhaap, asal thandak
blocks.text: 1 litre mein se 2 millilitre pani ke bhaap ban jane se baqi 998 millilitre ka darja-hararat 1 degree Celsius kam ho jata hai.
Cohesion

Pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds unhen "aapas mein chipke" rehne dete hain. Ek hi qisam ke molecules ki yeh kashish cohesion hai, aur pani ke molecules mein cohesion zyada hai. Poday pani aur ghizai ajza (nutrients) ko jaron se patton tak pohanchane ke liye pani ki cohesion par inhisar karte hain: patte se pani ki bhaap banna patte ki xylem naliyon ke pani par khinchao dalta hai, aur cohesion ki wajah se yeh quwwat xylem naliyon se ho kar neeche jaron tak pohanchti hai, is liye pani kashish-e-siql (gravity) ke khilaf upar chadhta hai. Hydrogen bonds pani ko oonchi surface tension bhi dete hain: pani aise hota hai jaise us par koi an-dekhi jhilli ho, isi liye water strider keera satah tore baghair pani par chalta hai.
Pani ka ionise hona (ionisation)

Jab pani ke molecule ke atoms ke darmiyan covalent bonds toot-te hain to pani ionise ho kar hydrogen ions (H+) aur hydroxyl ions (OH-) banata hai. Aam halaat mein yeh reaction ulat (reversible) sakta hai aur tawazun (equilibrium) qaim rehta hai. Kamre ke darja-hararat (25 degree Celsius) par ek litre pani mein har 550 million molecules mein se ek ionise hota hai, is liye khalis pani mein H+ aur OH- har ek ki concentration 10 ki power manfi 7 moles fi litre rehti hai. H+ aur OH- ions cells ke bohat se kemiyai reactions mein hissa lete hain, maslan macromolecules ki hydrolysis. H+ aur OH- ki nisbati concentrations kisi mahol ki tezabiyat (acidity) aur alkalinity, yani us ka pH, tay karti hain, jo biochemical reactions par asar dalta hai: enzymes khaas pH par behtareen kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Tezab aur bases
blocks.text: Tezab (acids) OH- ions se mil jate hain, mahol mein H+ ions chhor kar use tezabi banate hain. Bases H+ ions se mil jate hain, mahol mein OH- ions chhor kar use basic banate hain.
4 degree Celsius par zyada se zyada density

Pani 4 degree Celsius par apni zyada se zyada density dikhata hai, aur is se neeche darja-hararat girne par us ki density kam hoti hai, kyunke hydrogen bonds pani ke molecules ko nisbatan door rakhte hain. Jab darja-hararat 0 degree Celsius tak girta hai to pani jam jata hai, magar barf (ice) maaye pani se kam dense hoti hai, kyunke is darja-hararat par hydrogen bonding molecules ko maaye se zyada door rakhti hai. Dariyaon, nadiyon aur jheelon mein darja-hararat girne par satah ke pani par barf banti hai; kam dense hone ki wajah se yeh tairti hai, insulator ka kaam karti hai aur neeche ke pani se garmi nikalne nahin deti. Is tarah aabi (aquatic) jandar mehfooz rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Sardiyon mein ek talaab upar se jam jata hai. Pani ki do khususiyat se samjhayen ke neeche ki machhliyan kyun zinda rehti hain.
blocks.explanation: Barf maaye pani se kam dense hai kyunke 0 degree par hydrogen bonds molecules ko zyada door rakhte hain, is liye yeh upar tairti hai aur neeche ke pani ko insulate karti hai. Pani ki oonchi specific heat ka matlab hai ke neeche ka pani bohat aahista thanda hota hai, is liye machhliyon ke liye mustahkam darja-hararat par maaye rehta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pani jandaron ka 65 se 89 fisad aur zindagi ka zariya hai. Is ka molecule polar hai aur hydrogen bonds ka jaal banata hai.

Solvent: polar aur charge wale madde (namak, sugars, amino acids) hydrophilic hain aur hal hote hain; non-polar lipids hydrophobic hain aur bahar dhakele jate hain, jo membranes banane mein madad karta hai.

Oonchi specific heat (4.184 joules) darja-hararat mustahkam rakhti hai; ooncha heat of vaporisation (574 kilocalories fi kilogram) bhaap se thandak deta aur zameen ko motadil rakhta hai; cohesion pani ko xylem mein upar le jati hai aur surface tension deti hai.

H+ aur OH- mein ionise hona (har ek 10 ki power manfi 7 moles fi litre) pH tay karta hai; enzymes ko khaas pH chahiye. 4 degree par zyada se zyada density ka matlab barf tairti hai aur aabi zindagi ko insulate karti hai.
